en: A black and white photograph depicting a villa (house) with a garden, surrounded by trees and a picket fence. Three people stand in front of the house, two children and one man, suggesting a family scene. The house has a steep roof and wooden construction typical of Scandinavian architecture. The lower left corner reads 'Villa Åsen, Halmstad.' and the bottom right notes 'Foto: Otto Nilsson, Halmstad.' indicating the photographer and location.
